transform_bleu_score: normalize a BLEU score between 0 and 100 to a value between 0 and 1
transform_sari_score: normalize a SARI score between 0 and 60 to a value between 0 and 1
transform_fkgl_score: normalize a FKGL score between 0 and 20 to an inverted value between 0 and 1
combine_evaluation_metrics: combine BLEU, SARI, and FKGL scores into a single harmonic mean metric using coefficients
review_transform_functions: review the BLEU, SARI, and FKGL transform functions to understand normalization ranges and inversion logic
